# `junction` records

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from schemas/0.1/junction.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

An explicit T-node (ADR-0007 amendment 2, doc 03 §9, rank 35). The sequence is the wiring order; the
style is a display choice.

Not in v0: `fitting` (fluid tees, doc 11 §5.1).

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | `junction` |
| File | `pages/<page>.jsonl` |
| Rank | 35 |
| Status | implemented |
| Record version | 1 |
| Schema | [`junction.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/schemas/0.1/junction.schema.json) |

## Types

### JunctionStyle

How a junction is drawn.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: A dot.

   Shape: `"dot"`

2. **Form 2**: A bevelled corner: `{"bevel": {"orient": …}}`.

   Shape: object { `bevel`: [`BevelSpec`](#bevelspec) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `bevel` | [`BevelSpec`](#bevelspec) | yes |  | The payload of `JunctionStyle::Bevel`. |

### BevelSpec

The payload of `JunctionStyle::Bevel`.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `orient` | [`Orient2`](#orient2) | no |  | Orientation of the bevel; default `r0`. |

### JunctionWiring

The physical wires behind a junction (doc 03 §9.2).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"star"` | The first CP is wired to every other CP. |
| `"chain"` | Consecutive CPs are wired. |

### Orient2

Orientation: rotation clockwise on the sheet, optionally mirrored (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: one of `"r0"`, `"r90"`, `"r180"`, `"r270"`, `"m0"`, `"m90"`, `"m180"`, `"m270"`

### Pt2

A point [x, y] in nanometres, y downwards (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: array of (integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991), integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)) (at least 2 item(s), at most 2 item(s))

### SourceRef

The import provenance of a record (doc 14 §2.3, ADR-0004 amendment 1): the lineage and the source key
from which the record's ID `v5(lineage namespace, key)` was derived.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes |  | The source key, byte for byte (NFC), such as `qet:el:<uuid>`. |
| `lineage` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | The import lineage. |

### Uuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`
